name: What factors most impact the cost of changing a kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What factors most impact the cost of changing a kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest cost driver in a kitchen layout update is moving mechanical rough-ins, specifically plumbing, gas, and electrical lines. Keeping your sink, dishwasher, and range in their original positions while updating cabinet arrangements, tile, and finishes keeps expenses substantially lower. Relocating a sink across the room requires cutting into subfloors or running new drain vents, which brings in licensed trade coordination. Other major factors influencing total investment include removing structural walls, the extent of custom framing and drywall patching needed, and whether you select custom cabinetry over semi-custom configurations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moving plumbing, gas, and electrical lines drives up costs the most. Keeping major appliances and the sink in their original locations keeps the layout update much more affordable.
